MCP config diagnostics ⚠

[Conflicting scopes]
├ Server "pr-stdio" is defined in multiple scopes with different endpoints: user (/bin/false), project (python3 -I /tmp/sonda/bin/fake_mcp.py --flag x). OAuth tokens are stored per endpoint, so authenticating in one context will not carry over.
└ Keep the correct endpoint and remove the others: `claude mcp remove pr-stdio -s user` or `claude mcp remove pr-stdio -s project`
